description: Source code for a fuzzing test targeting WebSocket deflate stream functionality within the Chromium project, including classes for WebSocket stream simulation and fuzzing logic.

classes.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream
classes.description: A mock WebSocketStream implementation used for fuzz testing, generating frames based on fuzzed input.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads frames from fuzzed data, creating WebSocketFrame objects.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::WriteFrames
methods.description: Stub method returning an error, as writing is not used in fuzzing.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::GetSubProtocol
methods.description: Returns an empty string for subprotocol.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::GetExtensions
methods.description: Returns an empty string for extensions.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::CreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketFrame with fuzzed header and payload data.

methods.name: WebSocketDeflateStreamFuzz
methods.description: Sets up deflate stream with fuzzed parameters and reads frames.
